app.lightcourseconversionquestionhelp: Tick the first checkbox to enable this fallback. The setting checkbox below selects its true/false value. Valid authored settings, including false, are preserved.
app.lightcourseconversionitemgraphichelp: Fills missing or invalid graphics in existing items, including optional graphics. Valid images, item text and item order are preserved. No items are added or replaced by this setting.
app.lightcourseconversiondefaultshelp: Fallbacks used only when converting a saved Light Course to a Full Course. Tick a required field to configure a fallback. Valid authored values are preserved. Optional empty fields stay empty unless you explicitly enable a graphic placeholder for all items. Array-item paths ([]) apply to existing items; configure the whole array to supply missing items. All proposed changes must be reviewed before conversion.
app.lightcourseconversiongrouphelp: Choose an entry from one of the groups below to edit its conversion defaults. Only one entry is shown at a time; changes are kept when switching groups. Use Save to store all changes.
app.lightcourseconversionnestedhelp: This required field contains nested settings. Inside item arrays, only required fields without a usable installed default are shown. Installed defaults are used for other item fields; existing optional values are retained. Tick the checkbox to use the whole value as a fallback; valid authored values are still preserved. To fill graphics in existing items, use the separate Graphic placeholder for all items fields.
app.lightcourseconversionemptydefault: Enter a non-empty fallback for %{path}, or untick the field.
